definition_zh: 肿瘤；肿块；肿胀
definition_en: an abnormal mass of tissue, or a swollen area
core_image: 皮肤下鼓起一个硬硬的小包，慢慢变大
scene: 体检时，医生在病人背上摸到一个肿块，安排了进一步检查。During the checkup, the doctor felt a tumor on the back of the patient and ordered further tests.
sceneCN: 这里 tumor 是「肿块、肿瘤」（第 1 个义项：组织异常增生形成的团块）；句意：体检时，医生在病人背上摸到一个肿块，安排了进一步检查。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加形容词后缀构成，义为「肿瘤的；肿胀的」
由本词加「产生」词根与形容词后缀构成，义为「致瘤的」
由本词加「发生」词根构成，义为「肿瘤发生」

senses.title: An abnormal mass of tissue
senses.definition: a lump of tissue that grows abnormally, whether harmless or dangerous
senses.definitionCN: 异常生长的一团组织，无论无害还是危险
senses.example: The scan found a small tumor near the kidney.
senses.exampleCN: 扫描在肾脏附近发现一个小肿瘤。
senses.why: Latin tumor simply meant a swelling, and any new lump kept that bodily image.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 tumor 本意就是「肿胀」，任何新长出的团块都延续了这个身体意象。

senses.title: A cancerous growth
senses.definition: a mass of cells that can invade nearby tissue and spread
senses.definitionCN: 能侵犯邻近组织并转移的细胞团块
senses.example: The biopsy confirmed that the tumor was malignant.
senses.exampleCN: 活检确认这个肿瘤是恶性的。
senses.why: When doctors needed a neutral word for a growth, the old swelling noun became the medical term.
senses.whyCN: 当医生需要一个中性的词来指增生时，这个古老的「肿胀」名词就成了医学术语。

senses.title: A harmless lump
senses.definition: a growth that stays in place and does not spread
senses.definitionCN: 留在原处、不会转移的增生
senses.example: A benign tumor usually needs no urgent surgery.
senses.exampleCN: 良性肿瘤通常不需要紧急手术。
senses.why: The same word covers harmless lumps, so benign is added to draw the line.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词也涵盖无害的肿块，所以再加上 benign 来划清界线。

senses.title: A swelling of the body
senses.definition: an old or general sense of a swollen part of the body
senses.definitionCN: 身体某处肿起的古老或一般说法
senses.example: The old medical text spoke of a tumor of the leg.
senses.exampleCN: 那本古老的医学书提到腿部的一处肿胀。
senses.why: The oldest sense is plain swelling, before the word was narrowed to new growths.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意义就是单纯的肿胀，后来才缩小到指新生的团块。

intro.en: Tumor is Latin for a swelling, from tumere, to swell.
intro.cn: tumor 是拉丁语「肿胀」，来自 tumere（肿起）。

items.en: Tumere means to swell or be swollen.
items.cn: tumere 意为肿起、肿胀。

items.en: Tumor names a swelling or a swollen place.
items.cn: tumor 指肿胀或肿起的部位。

items.en: Old French tumeur carries the medical sense.
items.cn: 古法语 tumeur 承载医学含义。

items.en: English writes tumour for a swelling or a mass.
items.cn: 英语写作 tumour，指肿胀或团块。

items.en: American spelling settles as tumor, and medicine narrows it to growths.
items.cn: 美式拼写固定为 tumor，医学把词义缩小到增生团块。

note.en: Tumor belongs to the Latin swelling family and sits near the medical words for growths.
note.cn: tumor 属于拉丁语「肿胀」词族，并与表示增生的医学词汇相邻。

entries.definition: the British spelling of tumor
swollen or swelling
able to produce tumors
a new abnormal growth of tissue
a swollen place on the body
a disease of uncontrolled cell growth
entries.definitionCN: 癌症；细胞失控生长的疾病

normalIntro.en: Tumor is the Latin word for a swelling, so the word is a lump you can almost feel.
normalIntro.cn: tumor 就是拉丁语的「肿胀」，这个词本身就是能摸到的团块。

normal.en: Tumere, to swell, is the root behind tumor.
normal.cn: tumere（肿起）是 tumor 的词根。

normal.en: A benign tumor stays put; a malignant one spreads.
normal.cn: 良性肿瘤留在原处，恶性肿瘤会扩散。

normal.en: A brain tumor grows inside the skull.
normal.cn: 脑肿瘤长在颅骨里面。

normal.en: Surgeons remove a tumor when they can.
normal.cn: 条件允许时，外科医生会切除肿瘤。

normal.en: Tumorous means full of or like a tumor.
normal.cn: tumorous 表示长有肿瘤或像肿瘤的。

abstract.en: Feel a hard pea under the skin that slowly becomes a marble.
abstract.cn: 想象皮下有一颗硬豌豆，慢慢长成弹珠。

abstract.en: See a small knot of cells sending out roots.
abstract.cn: 想象一小团细胞向外伸出根须。

abstract.en: Picture a lump that stays quietly in one place.
abstract.cn: 想象一个团块安静地待在一处。

examples.en: The scan showed a tumor in the left lung.
examples.cn: 扫描显示左肺有一个肿瘤。

examples.en: Benign tumors do not spread to other organs.
examples.cn: 良性肿瘤不会转移到其他器官。

examples.en: The surgeon removed the tumor successfully.
examples.cn: 外科医生成功切除了肿瘤。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「突猛」——想象皮下「突」然鼓起一「猛」块；只是谐音联想，非词源。

root: 拉丁语 tumere（肿起）→ tumor（肿胀、肿块）→ 古法语 tumeur → 英语 tumor，核心义「肿起的团块」。

sensesIntro.en: Tumor starts as any swelling, then narrows to a new growth, splits into cancerous and harmless lumps, and keeps the old bodily sense.
sensesIntro.cn: tumor 先指任何肿胀，再缩小到新生团块，又分出恶性与良性两类，同时保留古老的「肿起」义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lump under the skin that slowly grows.
core.cn: 核心意象：皮下慢慢变大的团块。

branches.en: Any abnormal mass is the first sense.
branches.cn: 任何异常团块都是第一个义项。

branches.en: A spreading mass is the malignant sense.
branches.cn: 会转移的团块是恶性义。

branches.en: A fixed mass is the benign sense.
branches.cn: 固定不动的团块是良性义。

branches.en: Plain swelling is the oldest bodily sense.
branches.cn: 单纯的肿胀是最古老的身体义。

branches.en: Both the neutral lump and the cancerous growth share the mass image.
branches.cn: 中性团块与癌性增生共享同一个团块意象。

intro.en: Tumor is a Latin swelling noun, with English adjectives and a Greek suffix in its medical family.
intro.cn: tumor 是拉丁语表示肿胀的名词，医学词族里有英语形容词与希腊语词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin tumere means to swell, and tumor means a swelling.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tumere 意为肿起，tumor 意为肿胀。

items.example: Tumere is the swelling verb.
items.exampleCN: tumere 是表示肿起的动词。

items.example: Tumor is the swelling noun.
items.exampleCN: tumor 是表示肿胀的名词。

items.example: Tumidus describes a swollen part.
Tumour is common in British writing.
items.exampleCN: tumour 常见于英式写作用法。

items.example: Tumorous describes the tissue.
Tumoral cells grow without limits.
Tumorigenic means tumor-producing.
Tumorigenesis names tumor formation.
The suffix -genesis forms tumorigenesis.
The suffix -ous forms tumorous.
The suffix -al forms tumoral.

definition_zh: 苔原；冻原；苔原带；（喻）荒凉地带
definition_en: a treeless cold region with low vegetation, found near the Arctic or above the treeline
core_image: 一眼望不到树的开阔地，地面是苔藓、地衣和矮灌木，风把云推得很低
scene: 夏天极昼，地面只有苔藓、地衣和矮柳，远处一头驯鹿慢慢走过。Reindeer graze across the open tundra in summer.
sceneCN: 这里 tundra 指「苔原」（第 1 个义项：极地或高山树线以上、无树的开阔寒冷地带）；句意为夏天驯鹿在这片开阔苔原上吃草。

pos.zh: 苔原；冻原；苔原带（可数，复数 tundras）

derivatives.zh: tundra + biome（复合术语，无后缀）→ 苔原生物群系
tundra + climate（复合术语，无后缀）→ 苔原气候
tundra + soil（复合术语，无后缀）→ 苔原土壤
tundra + vegetation（复合术语，无后缀）→ 苔原植被
tundra + zone（复合术语，无后缀）→ 苔原带

senses.title: The treeless Arctic plain
senses.titleCN: 极地苔原：无树的开阔寒冷地带
senses.definition: a treeless plain in a cold region, covered with moss, lichen and low shrubs
senses.definitionCN: 寒冷地区无树的平地，覆有苔藓、地衣与低矮灌木
senses.example: Reindeer graze across the open tundra in summer.
senses.exampleCN: 夏天驯鹿在这片开阔苔原上吃草。
senses.why: tundra names a landscape defined by absence: no trees, a short season and ground that stays cold.
senses.whyCN: tundra 命名一种由「缺失」界定的景观：没有树、生长季短、地面长期寒冷。

senses.title: Alpine tundra above the treeline
senses.titleCN: 高山苔原：树线以上的无树地带
senses.definition: the treeless zone on a mountain above the local treeline
senses.definitionCN: 山地本地树线以上的无树地带
senses.example: Above the treeline lies a windswept alpine tundra.
senses.exampleCN: 树线之上是风大的高山苔原。
senses.why: altitude produces the same treeless cold conditions as latitude, so the word covers mountain zones too.
senses.whyCN: 高海拔与高纬度产生同样的无树寒冷条件，因此这个词也覆盖山地。

senses.title: Tundra vegetation
senses.titleCN: 苔原植被：苔藓、地衣与矮灌木
senses.definition: the plant community of mosses, lichens, grasses and dwarf shrubs
senses.definitionCN: 苔藓、地衣、禾草与矮灌木组成的植物群落
senses.example: Tundra vegetation grows only a few centimetres high.
senses.exampleCN: 苔原植被只长到几厘米高。
senses.why: the absence of trees leaves a low plant cover, and ecology names that cover as the tundra vegetation.
senses.whyCN: 树木缺失留下低矮植被，生态学把这层覆盖命名为苔原植被。

senses.title: Tundra soil and frozen subsoil
senses.definition: the thin, cold, often waterlogged soil above permafrost
senses.definitionCN: 永冻层之上薄、冷、常积水的土壤
senses.example: Tundra soil thaws only at the surface each summer.
senses.exampleCN: 苔原土壤每年夏天只在表层融化。
senses.why: the plants grow in a thin layer above frozen subsoil, so the word extends from landscape to soil.
senses.whyCN: 植物长在冻土之上的薄层里，因此这个词从景观延伸到土壤。

senses.title: The tundra as a biome
senses.titleCN: 苔原生物群系：环极的生物带
senses.definition: the circumpolar biome characterised by treeless vegetation and permafrost
senses.definitionCN: 以无树植被与永冻层为特征的环极生物群系
senses.example: The tundra biome circles the Arctic Ocean.
senses.exampleCN: 苔原生物群系环绕北冰洋。
senses.why: a landscape repeated around the pole becomes a biome, a unit of ecological classification.
senses.whyCN: 环绕极地重复出现的景观成为生物群系，即生态分类单位。

senses.title: The brief growing season
senses.titleCN: 苔原生长季：短暂的夏季花期
senses.definition: the short summer period when tundra plants flower and grow
senses.definitionCN: 苔原植物开花生长的短暂夏季
senses.example: The tundra blooms briefly in July.
senses.exampleCN: 苔原在七月短暂绽放。
senses.why: the short summer is the only window for growth, so the word also names that brief season.
senses.whyCN: 短暂的夏天是唯一的生长窗口，因此这个词也命名那段短季。

senses.title: A barren or empty field
senses.definition: any area or field seen as empty, cold and without growth
senses.definitionCN: 任何被视为空旷、寒冷、缺乏生长的领域
senses.example: Critics called the new district a cultural tundra.
senses.exampleCN: 批评者把新区称为文化上的荒原。
senses.why: the metaphor transfers the absence of trees and life to culture, leaving an image of barren openness.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻把「无树、少生命」的特征移到文化上，留下荒凉空旷的意象。

senses.title: Tundra climate
senses.titleCN: 苔原气候：冬季长而寒冷的气候型
senses.definition: a climate type with long cold winters and a short cool summer, supporting tundra
senses.definitionCN: 冬季漫长寒冷、夏季短暂凉爽、能维持苔原的气候类型
senses.example: Tundra climates have a month or two above freezing.
senses.exampleCN: 苔原气候只有一两个月高于冰点。
senses.why: the vegetation and frozen ground together imply a climate type, so the word extends to climate classification.
senses.whyCN: 植被与冻土共同蕴含一种气候型，因此这个词延伸到气候分类。

intro.en: Tundra was borrowed from Russian tundra, generally traced to Kildin Sami tundar 'treeless upland'; a Finnish source tunturi 'treeless hill' is also proposed. English took the word in the nineteenth century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: tundra 借自俄语 tundra，一般认为上溯基尔丁萨米语 tundar「无树高地」；也有芬兰语 tunturi「无树的山」一说。英语在 19 世纪借入。年代均为约数。

items.en: Russian tundra named the treeless north of Siberia, and English travel writing adopted it in the 1840s.
items.cn: 俄语 tundra 指西伯利亚无树的北方，英语游记在 1840 年代吸收了它。

items.en: The Russian word is generally derived from Kildin Sami tundar, meaning a treeless upland or flat-topped hill.
items.cn: 一般认为俄语词来自基尔丁萨米语 tundar，意为无树的高地或平顶山。

items.en: Finnish tunturi 'treeless hill' is an alternative source; the two words belong to the wider Finnic and Sami stock, so both accounts may be partly right.
items.cn: 芬兰语 tunturi「无树的山」是另一来源说；两词同属更广的芬兰语与萨米语族，因此两种说法可能各有部分道理。

items.en: Nineteenth-century explorers and geographers extended the word from Siberian local use to the whole circumpolar belt.
items.cn: 19 世纪的探险家与地理学家把该词从西伯利亚地方用法扩展到整个环极地带。

items.en: Twentieth-century ecology defines tundra by treeless vegetation, permafrost and a short growing season, separating it from taiga and steppe.
items.cn: 20 世纪生态学以无树植被、永冻层与短生长季界定苔原，把它与泰加林、草原区分开。

items.en: Source uncertain: the Sami and Finnish hypotheses coexist, and the exact borrowing path from Russian into English is not fully documented.
items.cn: 来源不确定（词根来源存疑）：萨米语说与芬兰语说并存，从俄语进入英语的确切借入路径也没有完整记载。

note.en: Group one holds the cold-climate biome words that are constantly swapped; group two holds the plainer descriptions of barren ground.
note.cn: 第一组是常被互换的寒带生物群系词；第二组是「荒芜地面」的朴素说法。

entries.definition: The northern coniferous forest belt south of the tundra; it has trees, which the tundra lacks.
entries.definitionCN: 苔原以南的北方针叶林带；它有树，而苔原没有。

entries.definition: A dry grassland of continental interiors, treeless but warm and grassy rather than frozen.
entries.definitionCN: 大陆内部的干旱草原，同样无树，但温暖多草而非冻结。

entries.definition: A tropical or subtropical grassland with scattered trees and a dry season.
entries.definitionCN: 热带或亚热带草原，散布树木并有旱季。

entries.definition: The vast treeless grassland of the South American lowlands, temperate rather than polar.
entries.definitionCN: 南美低地广阔的无树草原，属温带而非极地。

entries.definition: Land that supports little or no vegetation, without specifying cold or latitude.
entries.definitionCN: 几乎不长或完全不长植被的土地，未限定寒冷或纬度。

entries.definition: A cold desert of the polar regions, drier and even more barren than most tundra.
entries.definitionCN: 极区的寒冷荒漠，比多数苔原更干、更荒芜。

entries.definition: A grassy mountain zone above the treeline, greener and often lower than alpine tundra.
entries.definitionCN: 树线以上的草甸山地，比高山苔原更绿、通常更低。

entries.definition: An open, often peaty upland in temperate regions, treeless but not polar.
entries.definitionCN: 温带地区开阔、常含泥炭的高地，无树但不属极地。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real relatives, real compounds and real collocations, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的同族词、复合词与固定搭配，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Tundra means no trees: if you see a forest, you have moved south into taiga.
normal.cn: 苔原就是没有树：看到森林，说明已南移到泰加林。

normal.en: Reindeer, moss, lichen and dwarf willow are the four pictures that belong to tundra.
normal.cn: 驯鹿、苔藓、地衣与矮柳是属于苔原的四幅画面。

normal.en: Alpine tundra is the mountain version; Arctic tundra is the polar version; the word is the same.
normal.cn: 高山苔原是山地版，北极苔原是极地版，用的是同一个词。

normal.en: Tundra soil sits above permafrost: thin on top, frozen below.
normal.cn: 苔原土壤坐在永冻层之上：上面薄，下面冻。

normal.en: The growing season lasts weeks, so tundra plants flower almost at once.
normal.cn: 生长季只有几周，因此苔原植物几乎同时开花。

abstract.en: A tundra is a place where the forest has been subtracted and only patience remains.
abstract.cn: 苔原是被抽走了森林、只剩耐心的地方。

abstract.en: Some institutions are tundras: open, cold, and unable to grow anything tall.
abstract.cn: 有些机构就是苔原：开阔、寒冷，长不出任何高大的东西。

abstract.en: The tundra keeps its history in the permafrost, not in the trees it never had.
abstract.cn: 苔原把历史保存在永冻层里，而不是它从未拥有的树木里。

examples.en: The tundra turns green for a few weeks each summer.
examples.cn: 苔原每年夏天有几周变绿。

examples.en: Polar bears roam the coastal tundra in search of seals.
examples.cn: 北极熊在沿海苔原上游荡寻找海豹。

examples.en: Few trees survive in the tundra because the subsoil stays frozen.
examples.cn: 苔原上很少有树存活，因为底土长期冻结。

dict_mnemonic.text: tundra 借自俄语，一般认为出萨米语「无树高地」：记苔藓、地衣、矮柳、驯鹿、冻土、短生长季这六件套。

root: 借自俄语 tundra，一般认为上溯基尔丁萨米语 tundar「无树高地」，另有芬兰语 tunturi「无树的山」一说。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of tundra. A treeless landscape yields the alpine variant, the vegetation, the soil, the biome, the season, the metaphor and the climate type.
sensesIntro.cn: tundra 的八个义项。一种无树景观衍生出高山变体、植被、土壤、生物群系、生长季、比喻与气候型。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open plain with no trees, a carpet of moss and lichen, and reindeer moving across it.
core.cn: 核心意象：没有树的开阔平地，苔藓与地衣铺成地毯，驯鹿在其上走过。

branches.en: TWO ALTITUDES: the polar plain, then the same zone on a mountain.
branches.cn: 两个高度：先是极地平地，再是山上的同一地带。

branches.en: WHAT GROWS AND WHAT IT GROWS IN: the low plants, then the thin frozen soil.
branches.cn: 长什么与长在什么上：先是低矮植物，再是薄而冻结的土壤。

branches.en: THE WHOLE AND THE CLIMATE: the biome as a belt, then the climate that sustains it.
branches.cn: 整体与气候：先是作为地带的生物群系，再是维持它的气候。

branches.en: THE SHORT SEASON: the brief summer when everything flowers at once.
branches.cn: 短暂季节：万物同时开花的短夏。

branches.en: THE METAPHOR: any open, cold and unproductive field.
branches.cn: 比喻：任何开阔、寒冷、缺乏产出的领域。

intro.en: Tundra is a borrowing with no English affix or compound structure; its apparent -a ending is part of the Russian noun, not a suffix.
intro.cn: tundra 是借词，没有英语词缀或复合结构；词尾的 -a 属于俄语名词本身，并非后缀。

latinIntro.en: The word has no Latin cognate: it comes from Russian and probably from Sami. Latin campus and terra describe open ground but are unrelated.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁同族词：它来自俄语，且很可能来自萨米语。拉丁 campus 与 terra 也描述开阔地面，但并无同源关系。

items.example: The tundra stretches to the coast.
The map marks the tundras of the north.
items.exampleCN: 地图标出北方的各片苔原。

items.meaning: the low plant cover of a tundra
items.example: Tundra vegetation recovers slowly.

items.meaning: the climate type of tundra regions
items.example: Tundra climate has a very short summer.
Tundra soil is poor in nutrients.
The tundra biome is fragile.
Alpine tundra covers the ridge.

items.meaning: the tundra of the far north
items.example: Arctic tundra thaws for two months.
items.exampleCN: 北极苔原每年解冻两个月。

definition_zh: 曲调；旋律；调音；调校
definition_en: a series of musical notes that is pleasant to hear, or to adjust an instrument or an engine so that it works well
core_image: 一双手拧紧琴弦上的木栓，弦音渐渐对上
scene: 屋里有人弹着旧木琴，低声哼一段熟悉的旋律。She hummed a tune she had learned from her mother.
sceneCN: 这里 tune 是「曲调；旋律」（第 1 个义项：一串悦耳、可哼唱的乐音）；句意为她哼着一支从母亲那里学来的曲子。拧紧琴栓让音对上的那双手，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 tune 加 -er 构成，义为「调音器；调谐器」
由 tune 加 -ful 构成，义为「悦耳的」
由 tune 加 -less 构成，义为「不成调的；走调的」

senses.title: The hummed melody
senses.definition: a short series of musical notes that people can sing or remember easily
senses.definitionCN: 一段易于哼唱和记住的乐音
senses.example: She hummed a tune she had learned from her mother.
senses.exampleCN: 她哼着一支从母亲那里学来的曲子。
senses.why: In the Middle Ages a tune was simply a sound or a tone, and a string of tones became a melody.
senses.whyCN: 在中世纪，tune 只是声音或音调，一串音调便成了旋律。

senses.title: Making the note right
senses.definition: to adjust the strings or keys of an instrument so the notes are correct
senses.definitionCN: 调整乐器的弦或键，使音高正确
senses.example: He tuned the guitar before the concert began.
senses.exampleCN: 演出开始前他给吉他调了音。
senses.why: Since a tune is a tone, to tune is to bring an instrument into the right tone.
senses.whyCN: 既然 tune 是音调，那么 to tune 就是把乐器调进正确的音调。

senses.title: Fitting a machine to its best
senses.definition: to adjust an engine or a device so that it runs smoothly and efficiently
senses.definitionCN: 调整发动机或装置，使其运转顺畅高效
senses.example: The mechanic tuned the engine until it ran quietly.
senses.exampleCN: 机械师把发动机调校到运转安静为止。
senses.why: An engine also has to be brought into harmony, and the ear language travelled to machines.
senses.whyCN: 发动机也需要调到和谐状态，于是耳朵的语言走进了机器。

intro.en: Tune is a variant of tone, both from the Latin tonus, a stretched string and the sound it makes.
intro.cn: tune 是 tone 的变体，二者都来自拉丁语 tonus，指绷紧的弦以及它发出的声音。

items.en: Tonos meant a stretching, and then the pitch of a stretched string.
items.cn: tonos 意为拉紧，后指绷紧的弦的音高。

items.en: Tonus kept both the tension and the sound of a string.
items.cn: tonus 同时保留了弦的张力与声音。

items.en: French had ton for tone and tune for the sound of music.
items.cn: 法语用 ton 表示音调，用 tune 表示音乐的声音。

items.en: English tune named a sound or a mood as well as a melody.
items.cn: 中古英语 tune 既指声音、心情，也指旋律。

items.en: The verb extended from strings to engines and radios: tuned and tuned in.
items.cn: 动词从琴弦扩展到发动机与收音机：tuned 与 tuned in。

note.en: The first group shares the tune stem, the second holds other words for melody and pitch.
note.cn: 第一组共享 tune 词干，第二组收其他表示旋律与音高的词。

entries.definition: A device or person that tunes.
Pleasant to listen to.
Without a clear melody.
A series of notes that make a song.
The quality or pitch of a sound.
To change something slightly to fit better.

normalIntro.en: Tune is tone with a different vowel: a string held at the right tone makes a tune.
normalIntro.cn: tune 就是换了元音的 tone：弦定在正确的音调上，就成了曲子。

normal.en: In tune and out of tune are the two most useful phrases.
normal.cn: in tune 与 out of tune 是最有用的两个搭配。

normal.en: The past form simply adds d: tuned.
normal.cn: 过去式直接加 d：tuned。

normal.en: Tune in means listen to a station.
normal.cn: tune in 意为收听某个电台。

normal.en: The verb works for engines as well as instruments.
normal.cn: 这个动词既用于乐器也可用于发动机。

normal.en: The plural simply adds s: tunes.
normal.cn: 复数直接加 s：tunes。

abstract.en: A wooden peg turned a little until the string agrees.
abstract.cn: 木栓转一点，直到弦声对上。

abstract.en: Someone humming while walking, unaware of it.
abstract.cn: 一个人边走边哼，自己都没察觉。

abstract.en: Two voices meeting on the same note.
abstract.cn: 两个声音在同一个音上相遇。

examples.en: He whistled a tune from an old film as he worked.
examples.cn: 他一边干活一边吹着一支老电影里的曲子。

examples.en: The piano needs to be tuned before the concert.
examples.cn: 音乐会前钢琴需要调音。

examples.en: The team spent the summer tuning the machine.
examples.cn: 团队花了一个夏天调校这台机器。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吞」——旋律好听，一听就把它整个吞下去，就是 tune 这支曲调。

root: 拉丁语 tonus（紧绷的弦与音调），经古法语 tune 进入英语，与 tone 同源；同族词有 tuner、tuneful、tuneless。

sensesIntro.en: First the melody you can hum, then the act of tuning an instrument, then the act of tuning a machine.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是能哼出来的旋律，再是给乐器调音，最后是给机器调校。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a peg turned until the string answers.
core.cn: 核心意象：木栓转到弦声回应。

branches.en: The melody branch: notes put in a remembered order.
branches.cn: 旋律分支：按记得的顺序排好的音。

branches.en: The instrument branch: bringing strings to the right pitch.
branches.cn: 乐器分支：把弦调到正确的音高。

branches.en: The machine branch: harmony for an engine.
branches.cn: 机器分支：给发动机找和谐。

branches.en: The ear branch: both are judged by listening.
branches.cn: 耳朵分支：两者都靠听来评判。

branches.en: The adjustment branch: small turns make a difference.
branches.cn: 调整分支：小转一下就不同了。

intro.en: Tune is a short free stem that takes -er, -ful, and -less, as well as everyday compounds.
intro.cn: tune 是短小的自由词干，可接 -er、-ful、-less，也常构成日常搭配。

latinIntro.en: The Latin noun tonus sits behind both tune and tone, and the words below share that stretch of sound.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语名词 tonus 是 tune 与 tone 的共同来处，下面的词共享这段声音的张力。

items.example: One stem serves both noun and verb.
items.exampleCN: 一个词干兼顾名词与动词。

items.example: It forms tuner, the tuning device.
It forms tuneful, full of melody.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 tuneful，充满旋律的。

items.example: It forms tuneless, without melody.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 tuneless，没有旋律的。

items.example: The band knows fifty tunes.
The piano was tuned on Monday.
They are tuning the radio now.
An untuned violin sounds thin.
items.exampleCN: 未调音的小提琴声音发薄。

latinEntries.meaning: a stretch of string, a tone

definition_zh: 隧道；地道；挖隧道
definition_en: a long passage dug under the ground or through a hill, or the act of digging one
core_image: 山腹里一条两头透光的圆孔，汽车正从中间穿过
scene: 火车钻进山里，车窗外的光先暗下去，又在前方亮起来。The tunnel runs for nine kilometres under the mountain.
sceneCN: 这里 tunnel 是「隧道」（第 1 个义项：在地下山体中挖出的长通道）；句意为这条隧道在山下延伸九公里。两头透光的山腹圆孔，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 tunnel 加 -ing 构成，义为「隧道开凿」
由 tunnel 加 -er 构成，义为「隧道工人」
由 tunnel 加 -ed 构成，义为「挖了隧道的」

senses.title: The hole through the hill
senses.definition: a passage cut through earth or rock, usually for traffic
senses.definitionCN: 在土石中开凿出的通道，通常供交通使用
senses.example: The tunnel runs for nine kilometres under the mountain.
senses.exampleCN: 这条隧道在山下延伸九公里。
senses.why: The word names the hollow shape itself, a tube pushed through solid ground.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名的正是那个中空的形状：一根被推过实地里的管子。

senses.title: The animal burrow
senses.definition: a hole dug by a small animal for shelter
senses.definitionCN: 小动物为藏身挖出的洞道
senses.example: Rabbits had made a tunnel beneath the hedge.
senses.exampleCN: 兔子在树篱下挖了一条洞道。
senses.why: A rabbit performs the same act of pushing a passage, so the word covers its home too.
senses.whyCN: 兔子做的也是推出一条通道这件事，于是它们的家也叫 tunnel。

senses.title: The digging itself
senses.definition: to make a passage by digging through earth, or to move as if through one
senses.definitionCN: 挖掘地道穿过土石，或像钻洞一样前行
senses.example: Workers tunnelled through the cliff to reach the harbour.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们穿凿崖壁，好把路通到港口。
senses.why: The noun turns into a verb, so the passage and the act of making it share one word.
senses.whyCN: 名词转作动词，于是通道与开凿通道的动作共用同一个词。

intro.en: Tunnel is a diminutive of Old French ton, a barrel, because the first tunnels were round like a cask.
intro.cn: tunnel 是古法语 ton（木桶）的指小词，因为最早的隧道像横放的酒桶。

items.en: Ton meant a tun or barrel, a round hollow vessel made of staves.
items.cn: ton 意为大桶，是用板条箍成的圆形空器。

items.en: English took the diminutive tunel and first used it for a bird net shaped like a funnel.
items.cn: 英语借入指小形式 tunel，起初指漏斗状的捕鸟网。

items.en: The name shifted to the shaft or pipe through which something passes.
items.cn: 名称转指某物穿过的竖井或管道。

items.en: With canal and railway building it settled on a passage bored through earth.
items.cn: 随着运河与铁路的修建，词义固定为穿过土石的通道。

items.en: The verb followed, so to tunnel means to push out a cask-shaped passage.
items.cn: 动词随后出现，to tunnel 即推出一条桶状的通道。

note.en: The first group holds words sharing the barrel shape or the sound, the second holds other passages.
note.cn: 第一组收与桶形或读音相关的词，第二组收其他表示通道的词。

entries.definition: A cone-shaped tube for pouring.
A melody or a set adjustment.
A large barrel.
A way through or along something.
An underground railway or a walkway below a road.
A hole dug by an animal.

normalIntro.en: Tunnel carries the shape of a barrel inside its history and of a tube in its sound.
normalIntro.cn: tunnel 的历史里藏着桶形，读音里又藏着管子的样子。

normal.en: Double the l before -ed and -ing in British spelling.
normal.cn: 英式拼写中加 -ed、-ing 时双写 l。

normal.en: The stress is on the first syllable: TUN-nel.
normal.cn: 重音在第一个音节。

normal.en: Funnel and tunnel differ by one letter and both are hollow.
normal.cn: funnel 与 tunnel 只差一个字母，都是空心的。

normal.en: A tunnel has two mouths, one at each end.
normal.cn: 隧道有两口，一头一个。

normal.en: To tunnel is to make the noun with your hands.
normal.cn: to tunnel 就是用手把这个名词造出来。

abstract.en: A ring of daylight far ahead in the dark.
abstract.cn: 黑暗中远处一圈天光。

abstract.en: A rabbit hole sloping down under a hedge.
abstract.cn: 树篱下斜下去的一个兔洞。

abstract.en: Two lamps entering the rock and not coming out.
abstract.cn: 两盏灯进了岩层就没再出来。

examples.en: The tunnel was closed for repairs all weekend.
examples.cn: 隧道整个周末都在维修封闭。

examples.en: Engineers tunnelled beneath the river in only two years.
examples.cn: 工程师们只用两年就在河底挖通了隧道。

examples.en: A faint light showed at the end of the tunnel.
examples.cn: 隧道尽头透出一点微光。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吞哪」——火车一口把人和车吞进山肚子里，走的是隧道。

root: 源自中古英语 tunel、古法语 ton（大桶）的指小形式，本义为桶状的空心物，后指穿过土石的通道，同族词有 funnel、tun。

sensesIntro.en: First the passage through rock, then the smaller burrow of an animal, then the act of digging one.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是穿石的通道，再是动物的洞穴，最后是开凿这个动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tube of light through solid rock.
core.cn: 核心意象：穿透实岩的一管光。

branches.en: The passage branch: traffic moving through rock.
branches.cn: 通道分支：车辆穿过岩层。

branches.en: The animal branch: a smaller version of the same hole.
branches.cn: 动物分支：同一个洞的缩小版。

branches.en: The action branch: hands making the passage.
branches.cn: 动作分支：双手挖出通道。

branches.en: The engineering branch: plans become a bored tube.
branches.cn: 工程分支：图纸变成钻出的管道。

branches.en: The escape branch: a burrow used to get out.
branches.cn: 逃亡分支：用来逃出的地道。

intro.en: Tunnel is a stem plus the old dimunitive ending -el, and the family grows with -ing and -er.
intro.cn: tunnel 由词干加古老的指小后缀构成，词族靠 -ing、-er 扩展。

latinIntro.en: The French source goes back to a barrel word, and the related Latin forms are listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 其法语来源可追到一个表示桶的词，相关拉丁形式列在下面。

items.example: The tunnel is long.
Two tunnels cross the ridge.
They tunnelled all winter.
Tunnelling is slow work.
The tunneller wore a lamp.
items.exampleCN: 挖隧道的工人头上戴着灯。

items.meaning: a small one of the stem
items.example: It marks the small barrel.
Pour the oil through a funnel.
The old tun held wine.

definition_zh: 涡轮机；汽轮机；透平
definition_en: a machine with a wheel that is spun by steam, gas or water in order to produce power
core_image: 水流冲击一圈金属叶片，轮轴在轰鸣中飞速旋转
scene: 水坝底部的机房里，水从高处冲下来，推动一整排金属轮子。Each turbine in the plant can light a small town.
sceneCN: 这里 turbine 是「涡轮机」（第 1 个义项：靠蒸汽、燃气或水流冲转轮子来产生动力的机器）；句意为厂里每台涡轮机都能照亮一座小镇。水流冲击叶片、轮轴狂转的画面，就是这个词的样子。

derivatives.zh: 由 turbine 附近的词干构成，义为「陀螺状的」
由 turbine 加 driven 构成，义为「涡轮驱动的」
turbine 的缩略形式，义为「涡轮；涡轮增压器」

senses.title: The spinning wheel
senses.definition: a machine whose wheel is turned by a moving fluid, changing that motion into power
senses.definitionCN: 靠流动的流体带动轮子旋转、把转动变成动力的机器
senses.example: Each turbine in the plant can light a small town.
senses.exampleCN: 厂里每台涡轮机都能照亮一座小镇。
senses.why: The name points at the wheel itself, the part that turns.
senses.whyCN: 词名直指那个轮子，那个真正在转的部件。

senses.title: The engine built around it
senses.definition: a whole engine, as in a jet, that works by driving such a wheel
senses.definitionCN: 如喷气机中围着一个涡轮工作的整台发动机
senses.example: The aircraft is fitted with a new turbine.
senses.exampleCN: 这架飞机装有新型涡轮发动机。
senses.why: Because the wheel is the heart of the engine, the part name came to stand for the whole.
senses.whyCN: 轮子是发动机的心脏，于是部件的名字代替了整体。

intro.en: Turbine was coined in the nineteenth century from the Latin word for a whirl, turbinis.
intro.cn: turbine 是十九世纪用拉丁语中表示「漩涡」的词 turbinis 造出来的。

items.en: Turbo meant a whirl or a spinning top, and its genitive turbinis named the whirling thing.
items.cn: turbo 意为漩涡或陀螺，其属格 turbinis 命名旋转之物。

items.en: French engineers used the Latin stem in the vocabulary of early hydraulic machinery.
items.cn: 法国工程师在早期水力机械的词汇里用上了这个拉丁词干。

items.en: In the eighteen twenties the word was given to a wheel spun by water.
items.cn: 十九世纪二十年代，这个词被赋予被水流冲转的轮子。

items.en: Steam engines then used turbines for a far greater spinning force.
items.cn: 蒸汽机随后用涡轮机取得大得多的旋转力。

items.en: Jets and power stations made it an everyday word for a machine that whirls.
items.cn: 喷气机与电站使它成为「旋转的机器」的日常用词。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin whirl, the second names power machines.
note.cn: 第一组共享拉丁语「旋转」词根，第二组是动力机器的名称。

entries.definition: A turbine or a turbocharger.
Rough, unsettled movement.
To break someone's calm.
A machine that produces motion.
A machine that makes electricity.
The turning part of a machine.

normalIntro.en: Turbine and turbulence come from the same Latin whirl, so the machine is a tame tempest.
normalIntro.cn: turbine 与 turbulence 同出拉丁语的「旋转」，所以这台机器是一头被驯服的旋风。

normal.en: The second syllable carries the stress in British speech: TUR-bine.
normal.cn: 英式发音重音多在第二音节。

normal.en: Turbine shares its stem with disturb and turbulence.
normal.cn: turbine 与 disturb、turbulence 共享词干。

normal.en: A turbine turns a flow of fluid into a turn of the shaft.
normal.cn: 涡轮机把流体的流动变成轴的转动。

normal.en: Turbo is the clipped, faster form of the same word.
normal.cn: turbo 是同一个词的缩略快读形式。

normal.en: Nothing spins without blades, so picture the blades first.
normal.cn: 没有叶片什么也转不起来，先想叶片。

abstract.en: A ring of blades catching a column of water.
abstract.cn: 一圈叶片接住一股水柱。

abstract.en: A whirlpool seen from above, frozen in metal.
abstract.cn: 从上方看去的漩涡，凝在金属里。

abstract.en: The low hum of a hall full of spinning wheels.
abstract.cn: 一屋子里满是转轮的低声轰鸣。

examples.en: Wind turbines line the ridge above the village.
examples.cn: 风力涡轮机排在小村上方的山脊上。

examples.en: A damaged turbine can cut the station's output by half.
examples.cn: 一台受损的涡轮机能让电站发电量减半。

examples.en: The turbine spins thousands of times a minute.
examples.cn: 这台涡轮机每分钟转几千次。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「特别一拧」——一拧开就疯狂旋转，正是涡轮机。

root: 来自拉丁语 turbo（漩涡、陀螺）的属格 turbinis，本义为旋转之物，十九世纪用以称呼被水流或蒸汽冲转的轮子，同族词有 turbulence、disturb、turbo。

sensesIntro.en: First the spinning wheel, then the whole engine built around that wheel.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是那个在转的轮子，再是围着这个轮子造出的整台发动机。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: water striking a ring of blades.
core.cn: 核心意象：水撞上一圈叶片。

branches.en: The wheel branch: fluid turned into spin.
branches.cn: 轮子分支：流体变为旋转。

branches.en: The engine branch: the whole machine takes the part's name.
branches.cn: 发动机分支：整体借用了部件的名字。

branches.en: The power branch: spin becomes electricity.
branches.cn: 电力分支：旋转变成电。

branches.en: The wind branch: air does the same work as water.
branches.cn: 风分支：空气做着与水相同的工作。

branches.en: The flight branch: a jet rides on its turbines.
branches.cn: 飞行分支：喷气机靠涡轮飞行。

intro.en: Turbine is a Latin stem with a noun ending, and its relatives cluster around the idea of whirling.
intro.cn: turbine 是带名词词尾的拉丁词干，其亲属词都围绕「旋转」聚拢。

latinIntro.en: Latin turbo and its family supplied several English words about disturbing and whirling.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 turbo 及其词族贡献了若干表示搅动与旋转的英语词。

items.example: The turbine is new.
The car has a turbo.
It closes the word turbine.
items.exampleCN: 它收束了 turbine 这个词。

items.example: The plane hit turbulence.
A turbulent river.
Do not disturb him.
A loud disturbance outside.
The water was turbid.

definition_zh: 营业额；人员流动率；周转率
definition_en: the total amount of money a business receives in a period, or the rate at which staff or stock is replaced
core_image: 货物从货架这头转到那头，钱在柜台里转了一圈又回来
scene: 季度结算时，财务经理报出公司的销售总额。The finance manager reported the company turnover for the quarter.
sceneCN: 这里 turnover 是「营业额」（第 1 个义项：一定时期内的销售总额）；句意：季度结算时，财务经理报出了公司的营业额。

pos.zh: 营业额；人员流动率；周转率

derivatives.zh: 翻转；移交；把……转手
翻倒；推翻（over 与 turn 换位构成的近亲）
好转；周转时间（turn 与 around 构成的复合词）

senses.title: The money taken in a period
senses.definition: the total amount of money a business receives from sales in a period
senses.definitionCN: 企业在某一时期内通过销售收到的款项总额
senses.example: Annual turnover rose by a fifth last year.
senses.exampleCN: 去年年营业额上升了五分之一。
senses.why: The phrasal verb turn over means to hand money across a counter, so turnover became the money that passes through a business.
senses.whyCN: 短语动词 turn over 指把钱从柜台上转手；流经企业的钱于是被称为 turnover，即营业额。

senses.title: The rate at which staff are replaced
senses.definition: the proportion of employees who leave and are replaced during a period
senses.definitionCN: 一段时间内离职并被替换的员工所占的比例
senses.example: High turnover is costly for the firm.
senses.exampleCN: 人员流动率高对公司来说代价很大。
senses.why: People turn over in a job as posts are vacated and refilled, so the same word names staff replacement.
senses.whyCN: 员工像岗位上的「翻转」一样离开又被补上，同一个词就用来指人员流动率。

senses.title: The rate at which stock is sold
senses.definition: the speed at which goods are sold and replaced in a shop or store
senses.definitionCN: 商店里的货物卖出并被补货的速度
senses.example: Fast turnover keeps the stock fresh.
senses.exampleCN: 周转快能让存货保持新鲜。
senses.why: Stock turns over as it is sold and replaced, which gives the stock sense of the word.
senses.whyCN: 存货卖出又补货，像在货架上「翻转」一轮，于是有了存货周转的意思。

senses.title: A loss of possession in sport
senses.definition: the act of losing the ball to the other team in a game
senses.definitionCN: 比赛中把球丢给对方球队的行为
senses.example: The coach blamed the turnover for the defeat.
senses.exampleCN: 教练把失利归咎于那次丢球。
senses.why: A team turns the ball over to the other side, so a lost possession is a turnover.
senses.whyCN: 球队把球「转交」给对方，丢掉的球权就叫 turnover。

senses.title: A folded pastry
senses.definition: a small pie made by folding pastry over a fruit or meat filling
senses.definitionCN: 把面皮翻转折叠、包住水果或肉馅的小点心
senses.example: She bought an apple turnover at the bakery.
senses.exampleCN: 她在面包店买了一只苹果酥饼。
senses.why: Pastry is turned over and folded around the filling, which names the little pie.
senses.whyCN: 面皮被「翻转」折起来包住馅料，这种小点心因此得名。

intro.en: Turnover is the English compound of turn and over; turn goes back through Old French to Latin tornare, to turn on a lathe.
intro.cn: turnover 是 turn 与 over 构成的英语复合词；turn 经古法语可追溯到拉丁语 tornare，意为在车床上转动。

items.en: Tornare means to turn on a lathe, from tornus, a lathe.
items.cn: tornare 意为在车床上转动，源于 tornus（车床）。

items.en: Torner carries the verb into French with the sense of turning.
items.cn: torner 把这个动词带入法语，表示转动。

items.en: Turn enters English and names a circular movement.
items.cn: 十三世纪起，turn 进入英语，指圆周式的转动。

items.en: Over adds the sense of moving across or from one side to the other.
items.cn: over 增添「越过、从一侧到另一侧」的意思。

items.en: Turnover names the amount of money taken in a period.
items.cn: 十九世纪起，turnover 指一段时期内进账的金额。

items.en: The word also names the replacement of staff and the rotation of stock.
items.cn: 现代英语中，这个词也指人员替换与存货周转。

note.en: Turnover is the compound of turn and over, close to turn over, overturn and turnaround, and to the revenue words of accounting.
note.cn: turnover 是 turn 与 over 的复合词，与 turn over、overturn、turnaround 形近，也与会计里的收入类词相邻。

entries.definition: to flip something or hand it across
to tip over or reverse a decision
a complete change for the better
money received from sales
the total value of goods sold
money left after costs are paid

normalIntro.en: Turnover is turn plus over: money, staff and stock all turn over and come round again.
normalIntro.cn: turnover 是 turn 加 over：钱、人和货都在「转一圈」，然后又回来。

normal.en: Turnover is the money that turns over in a business during a period.
normal.cn: turnover 是一段时期内企业里「转一圈」的钱，即营业额。

normal.en: Staff turnover measures how many people leave and are replaced.
normal.cn: staff turnover 衡量有多少人离开又被替换。

normal.en: Stock turnover measures how fast goods are sold.
normal.cn: stock turnover 衡量货物卖得多快。

normal.en: Turn over a page and you move it to the other side; turn over money and it changes hands.
normal.cn: turn over a page 是把书页翻到另一面；turn over money 是让钱转手。

normal.en: Compare revenue: revenue is accounting income, turnover is the sales total.
normal.cn: 对比 revenue：revenue 是会计口径的收入，turnover 是销售总额。

abstract.en: Picture a coin spinning on a counter and coming back.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚硬币在柜台上转了一圈又回来。

abstract.en: Picture a revolving door with people going out and in.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇旋转门，人不断走出又走进。

abstract.en: Picture boxes sliding off a shelf and new ones taking their place.
abstract.cn: 想象箱子滑下货架，新箱子补上位置。

examples.en: The firm has an annual turnover of about two million pounds.
examples.cn: 这家公司的年营业额约为两百万英镑。

examples.en: Staff turnover has fallen since the new pay scheme.
examples.cn: 自新薪酬方案实施以来，员工流动率下降了。

examples.en: An apple turnover was warming in the bakery window.
examples.cn: 面包店的橱窗里，一只苹果酥饼正热着。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「turnover」读近「腾欧沃」——货物「腾」出去、人「挪」走、钱「转」回来，营业额与流动率都在其中；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 英语 turn（转动，源自拉丁语 tornare「在车床上转」）+ over（越过、翻过）→ turn over（翻转；移交）→ turnover（流转的总额：营业额、人员流动率、周转率）。

sensesIntro.en: Turnover starts as money that turns over in trade, then extends to staff and stock that are replaced, to a lost ball, and to a folded pastry.
sensesIntro.cn: turnover 从买卖中「转一圈」的钱开始，再扩展到被替换的员工与存货、丢掉的球权，以及折叠而成的酥饼。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: goods and money turning over and coming back round.
core.cn: 核心意象：货物与钱转了一圈又回来。

branches.en: The sales total is the accounting core.
branches.cn: 销售总额是会计上的核心义。

branches.en: Staff replacement extends the turning image to people.
branches.cn: 人员替换把「翻转」的意象扩展到人。

branches.en: Stock rotation extends it to goods on a shelf.
branches.cn: 存货周转把意象扩展到货架上的货物。

branches.en: A lost ball is a turn of possession to the other side.
branches.cn: 丢球就是把球权转交给对方。

branches.en: A folded pastry is pastry turned over on itself.
branches.cn: 折叠酥饼就是把面皮翻转包起来。

intro.en: Turnover is an English compound of turn and over; turn itself goes back through Old French to Latin tornare.
intro.cn: turnover 是 turn 与 over 构成的英语复合词；turn 经古法语可追溯到拉丁语 tornare。

latinIntro.en: Latin tornare means to turn on a lathe, from tornus, a lathe; over is Germanic and adds the sense of across.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tornare 意为在车床上转动，源于 tornus（车床）；over 属日耳曼语，增添「越过」之义。

items.example: Turn names the circular movement.

items.meaning: across, from one side to the other
items.example: Over adds the crossing movement.
items.exampleCN: over 增添越过、横跨的动作。

items.meaning: to flip something or hand it over
items.example: Turn over joins the two halves.
items.exampleCN: turn over 把两半合在一起。

items.meaning: the money a business takes in a period
items.example: Turnover is the money that passes through.
Overturn swaps the two parts.
items.exampleCN: overturn 把两部分换了位置。

items.example: Turnaround adds around to turn.
items.exampleCN: turnaround 在 turn 后加上 around。

items.meaning: a gate that turns to let one person through
items.example: Turnstile joins turn and stile.
items.exampleCN: turnstile 由 turn 与 stile 构成。

items.meaning: ready to use as soon as it is handed over
items.meaningCN: 交钥匙的；可直接使用的
items.example: Turnkey describes a project handed over ready to use.
items.exampleCN: turnkey 形容交付即可使用的项目。

definition_zh: 家庭教师；导师；辅导
definition_en: a teacher who works with one student or a small group, or to teach in this way
core_image: 书桌两侧对坐的两个人，一个讲一道题，一个握笔在算
scene: 放学后的图书馆角落，两名学生隔着桌子低声讨论数学。His tutor showed him a shorter way to solve the equation.
sceneCN: 这里 tutor 是「家庭教师；导师」（第 1 个义项：单独或小班辅导学生的老师）；句意为他的导师教他一种更短的解题方法。两人隔着书桌对坐的画面，就是这个词的样子。

derivatives.zh: 由 tutor 加 -ial 构成，义为「辅导课」
由同一拉丁词根构成，义为「学费；教学」
由 tutor 加 -ing 构成，义为「辅导工作」

senses.title: The one beside you
senses.definition: a teacher who gives lessons to one learner or a small group
senses.definitionCN: 给一名学生或一小群人单独授课的老师
senses.example: His tutor showed him a shorter way to solve the equation.
senses.exampleCN: 他的导师教他一种更短的解题方法。
senses.why: A tutor is close enough to watch one person think, which is what separates the role from a class teacher.
senses.whyCN: 家教近到能看着一个人思考，这正是它区别于班级教师的地方。

senses.title: The guide at college
senses.definition: a member of staff who advises a student on study and progress
senses.definitionCN: 在大学里就学业与进度指导学生的工作人员
senses.example: Every first-year student is assigned a tutor.
senses.exampleCN: 每位一年级学生都分配一位导师。
senses.why: The university kept the word for the person who guards a student's course, not just one subject.
senses.whyCN: 大学保留这个词，指照看学生整个课程而不只是某一科的人。

senses.title: The act of guiding
senses.definition: to teach one person or a few people, often outside school
senses.definitionCN: 常在校外对一人或数人进行教学
senses.example: She tutors two children in reading on Saturdays.
senses.exampleCN: 她每周六给两个孩子辅导阅读。
senses.why: The noun becomes a verb: to be the tutor is to do what a tutor does.
senses.whyCN: 名词转动词：当导师就是做导师该做的事。

intro.en: Tutor comes from Latin tueri, to watch over, the same root as tutelage and tuition.
intro.cn: tutor 来自拉丁语 tueri（看守、守护），与 tutelage、tuition 同根。

items.en: Tueri meant to look after or guard someone or something.
items.cn: tueri 意为照看、守护某人或某物。

items.en: Tutor named the guardian, the one who watches over another.
items.cn: tutor 指守护者，即看护他人的人。

items.en: French carried tutor in the sense of a legal guardian.
items.cn: 法语传入 tutor 时带有法定监护人的意思。

items.en: English used it for a guardian before it became a word for a teacher.
items.cn: 英语先把它用作监护人，后来才转为教师。

items.en: The teaching sense won: the one who guards a learner now guards the learning.
items.cn: 教学义胜出：守护学习者的人，如今守护的是学习本身。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin root, the second names other teaching roles.
note.cn: 第一组共享拉丁词根，第二组是其他教学角色。

entries.definition: A small teaching session.
Teaching, or the fee for it.
The care of a guardian or teacher.
A person who teaches a class.
An experienced adviser.
A trainer who prepares someone.

normalIntro.en: Tutor keeps the old meaning of guarding: the teacher who watches over one learner.
normalIntro.cn: tutor 保留着守护的古义：盯着一个学生学的老师。

normal.en: Tutor, tuition and tutelage all start from the same Latin watch.
normal.cn: tutor、tuition、tutelage 都起自同一个拉丁语的「看」。

normal.en: The British stress is on the first syllable, the American one is closer to too.
normal.cn: 英式重音在前，美式首元音近于 too。

normal.en: As a verb it takes an object and often in: tutor him in maths.
normal.cn: 作动词时常接 in：tutor him in maths。

normal.en: A tutor teaches one, a class teacher teaches many.
normal.cn: 家教教一个，班级教师教一群。

normal.en: Tutorial is the session, tutor is the person.
normal.cn: tutorial 是课，tutor 是人。

abstract.en: Two chairs pulled close to one desk.
abstract.cn: 两把椅子拉到同一张桌子旁。

abstract.en: A pencil marking the same sum a second time.
abstract.cn: 一支铅笔把同一道题再标一遍。

abstract.en: A lamp left on over a late page.
abstract.cn: 深夜仍亮在某页书上的灯。

examples.en: Her parents found a tutor for the final term.
examples.cn: 她父母为最后一个学期请了家教。

examples.en: He tutors village children in maths for free.
examples.cn: 他免费给村里的孩子辅导数学。

examples.en: My tutor asked whether I had chosen a topic yet.
examples.cn: 我的导师问我是否已经选好题目。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「兔特」——老师像盯着兔子一样盯着一个学生学，就是家教。

root: 源自中古英语 tutour、古法语 tutor，上溯拉丁语 tutor（守护者）与动词 tueri（看守），本义为看护学习的人，同族词有 tuition、tutorial、tutelage。

sensesIntro.en: First the teacher who sits beside one learner, then the university guide, then the act of doing that work.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是坐在一个学生旁边的老师，再是大学里的导师，最后是做这件事本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two chairs drawn up to one desk.
core.cn: 核心意象：两把椅子拉到同一张桌边。

branches.en: The near teacher branch: one desk, one learner.
branches.cn: 近身教师分支：一桌一学生。

branches.en: The guardian branch: the college keeps the old watch.
branches.cn: 守护分支：大学保留了古老的看护。

branches.en: The act branch: doing what the guardian does.
branches.cn: 动作分支：做守护者所做的事。

branches.en: The lesson branch: the desk is where both meet.
branches.cn: 功课分支：书桌是双方相遇之处。

branches.en: The study branch: progress is followed week by week.
branches.cn: 学业分支：进度被一周周跟进。

intro.en: Tutor is a Latin agent form, and the family grows with -ial and -ion.
intro.cn: tutor 是拉丁语的施动形式，词族靠 -ial、-ion 扩展。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb tueri, to watch over, supplies the whole family, listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语动词 tueri（看守）供应了整个词族，列在下面。

items.example: The tutor arrived early.
Many tutors work here.
He tutored her for a year.
Tutoring pays little.
It forms tutorial.
A tutorial lasts an hour.
It forms tuition.
Tuition rose again.

definition_zh: 辅导课；教程；个别指导
definition_en: a small class in which a tutor teaches one student or a few students, or a short lesson that teaches a skill
core_image: 导师和学生围着一个小桌，逐句讨论
scene: 周三下午，导师把三名学生叫到办公室，让他们轮流讲解上周读过的文章。On Wednesday the tutor meets three students for a tutorial in her office.
sceneCN: 这里 tutorial 是「辅导课」（第 1 个义项：导师带少量学生讨论的课）；句意：周三导师在她的办公室给三名学生上一堂辅导课。

derivatives.zh: tutorial 的基础词，义为「导师；家教」
tutor 加 -ing 构成的名词，义为「个别辅导」
由拉丁语 tutela 进入英语，义为「指导；监护」

senses.title: A small university class
senses.definition: a small class at a university in which a tutor discusses work with a few students
senses.definitionCN: 大学里由导师带几名学生的讨论式小课
senses.example: Every student must attend one tutorial each week.
senses.exampleCN: 每个学生每周都必须上一堂辅导课。
senses.why: The Latin tutor watches over a learner, so the first sense is the small class where that watching happens.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 tutor 本义是照看学习者的人，所以第一个义项就是这种照看发生的那个小班课。

senses.title: A lesson for one or a few
senses.definition: a lesson given to one student or a very small group, often outside a normal class
senses.definitionCN: 给一个学生或很小的几个人上的课，常在正常课堂之外
senses.example: She booked a tutorial to prepare for the speaking test.
senses.exampleCN: 她约了一节辅导课来准备口语考试。
senses.why: The watching-over can be done for a single learner, so tutorial also names one-to-one teaching.
senses.whyCN: 照看可以只针对一个学习者进行，于是 tutorial 也指一对一的个别教学。

senses.title: A lesson inside a program
senses.definition: an interactive lesson inside a program that teaches a user how to use it
senses.definitionCN: 程序内部引导用户学会使用它的互动课程
senses.example: The app opens with a short tutorial on setting up a profile.
senses.exampleCN: 这个应用一打开就有一节简短教程，讲怎么建立个人资料。
senses.why: Modern software borrowed the teaching word for a guided lesson built into a product.
senses.whyCN: 现代软件借用了这个教学词，用来指产品里内置的引导式课程。

senses.title: A step-by-step guide
senses.definition: a written or filmed guide that teaches a skill step by step
senses.definitionCN: 用文字或影像一步一步教人某项技能的指南
senses.example: Her blog has a free tutorial on making a simple budget.
senses.exampleCN: 她的博客上有一篇免费教程，讲怎么做简单的预算。
senses.why: Once a lesson can be written down, any guide that teaches a skill becomes a tutorial.
senses.whyCN: 课既然可以写下来，任何一步一步教人技能的指南也就成了 tutorial。

senses.title: A single unit of an online course
senses.definition: one short unit of an online course that teaches a particular skill
senses.definitionCN: 在线课程中教某一项技能的一个短单元
senses.example: The course is split into ten short tutorials.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课被分成十节短课。
senses.why: Online courses keep the tutorial as the unit of teaching, a small watched-over step in a larger course.
senses.whyCN: 在线课程仍把 tutorial 当作教学单元，也就是大课程里被照看着走完的一小步。

intro.en: Tutorial comes from Latin tutor, a guardian, from tueri, to watch over or protect; the suffix -ial gives the sense of what belongs to a tutor.
intro.cn: tutorial 来自拉丁语 tutor（守护者、导师），而 tutor 出自动词 tueri（照看、守护）；后缀 -ial 表示「与导师有关的」。

items.en: Tueri means to watch over, guard, or protect.
items.cn: tueri 意为照看、守护、保护。

items.en: Tutor is the guardian, the person who watches over someone.
items.cn: tutor 是守护者，也就是照看某人的人。

items.en: Tutela names the protection itself, and the family keeps the watching-over image.
items.cn: tutela 指保护本身，这个词族一直保留着照看的意象。

items.en: English first uses tutorial as an adjective meaning of or belonging to a tutor.
items.cn: 英语最初把 tutorial 用作形容词，意为属于导师的。

items.en: At Oxford and Cambridge the noun tutorial comes to name the small class in which a tutor questions students.
items.cn: 在牛津与剑桥，名词 tutorial 逐渐指导师提问学生的那种小班课。

note.en: Tutorial grows from Latin tueri, to watch over, through tutor, and stands beside tutor, tutelage, and tutee; it sits near seminar, workshop, and lecture.
note.cn: tutorial 从拉丁语 tueri（照看）经 tutor 长出来，与 tutor、tutelage、tutee 相邻，并与 seminar、workshop、lecture 意义相近。

entries.definition: a teacher who guides one student or a small group
entries.definitionCN: 导师；家教，是 tutorial 的基础词

entries.definition: guidance or protection given by a tutor
entries.definitionCN: 指导；监护，同出拉丁语 tueri（照看）

entries.definition: a student who is taught by a tutor
entries.definitionCN: 受辅导的学生，由 tutor 加 -ee 构成

entries.definition: a class in which a small group discusses a topic
entries.definitionCN: 研讨课，以小组讨论为主，规模常大于 tutorial

entries.definition: a practical session in which people learn by doing
a formal talk given to a large group of students
entries.definitionCN: 讲座，面向大班讲授，与小组辅导相对

normalIntro.en: Tutorial grows from the Latin verb tueri, to watch over, by way of tutor, the one who guards a learner.
normalIntro.cn: tutorial 从拉丁语动词 tueri（照看）经 tutor（守护学习者的人）长出来。

normal.en: Tutor is the person and tutorial is the class: tutor plus -ial.
normal.cn: tutor 是人，tutorial 是课，即 tutor 加 -ial 构成。

normal.en: Tueri, to watch over, is the Latin verb behind both words.
normal.cn: tueri 意为照看，是这两个词共同的拉丁语动词。

normal.en: At university a tutorial is much smaller than a lecture.
normal.cn: 在大学里，tutorial 比 lecture 小得多。

normal.en: An online tutorial teaches one skill in a short guided lesson.
normal.cn: online tutorial 用一节简短的引导课教一项技能。

normal.en: Compare seminar: a seminar is a discussion group, while a tutorial is guided teaching in a very small group.
normal.cn: 对比 seminar：seminar 是讨论小组，tutorial 是极小班里的引导式教学。

abstract.en: Picture a tutor leaning over a table to point at a line in a book.
abstract.cn: 想象导师俯身指着书上一行字。

abstract.en: Picture one student and one teacher at a corner desk.
abstract.cn: 想象一张角落的书桌，一个学生和一个老师。

abstract.en: Picture a screen with a small arrow showing the next step.
abstract.cn: 想象屏幕上有一个小箭头，指向下一步。

examples.en: The tutorial lasts fifty minutes and covers the reading for the week.
examples.cn: 这堂辅导课持续五十分钟，讲这一周的阅读材料。

examples.en: New students are assigned to a tutorial group in their first term.
examples.cn: 新生在第一学期会被分到一个辅导小组。

examples.en: He watched a short tutorial before using the design tool.
examples.cn: 他用这个设计工具之前先看了一段短教程。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「图特瑞尔」——导师带着你图个明白，就是辅导课；谐音联想，不是词源。

root: 拉丁语 tueri（照看、守护）→ 拉丁语 tutor（守护者、导师）→ 英语 tutor → 加形容词后缀 -ial 得 tutorial，先作形容词「导师的」，十九世纪起指导师带的小班辅导课，核心义「有人照看着学」。

sensesIntro.en: Tutorial starts from the tutor who watches over a learner and comes to name the small class, the one-to-one lesson, the software lesson, the written guide, and the unit of an online course.
sensesIntro.cn: tutorial 从照看学习者的导师出发，进而指小班辅导课、一对一辅导、软件内置课程、书面指南以及在线课程的一个单元。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tutor and two students around a small table with books open.
core.cn: 核心意象：导师和两名学生围着一张小桌，书摊开着。

branches.en: The small university class is the original noun sense.
branches.cn: 大学小班课是最早的名词义项。

branches.en: Teaching one learner is the individual sense.
branches.cn: 只教一个学习者是个别辅导义项。

branches.en: A lesson inside software is the digital sense.
branches.cn: 软件内置的课程是数字化义项。

branches.en: A written guide is the self-study sense.
branches.cn: 书面指南是自学义项。

branches.en: One unit of an online course is the course-structure sense.
branches.cn: 在线课程的一个单元是课程结构义项。

intro.en: Tutorial is built on the Latin verb tueri, to watch over, through the noun tutor, a guardian, plus the adjective suffix -ial.
intro.cn: tutorial 建在拉丁语动词 tueri（照看、守护）之上，经名词 tutor（守护者）再加形容词后缀 -ial 构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin tueri means to watch over or protect; tutor is the one who does it, and tutela is the protection itself.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tueri 意为照看、保护；tutor 是执行照看的人，tutela 则是保护本身。

items.example: Tueri gives the watching-over image.
items.exampleCN: tueri 提供照看这一意象。

items.example: Tutor is the person who watches over a learner.
items.exampleCN: tutor 是照看学习者的人。

items.example: Tutela names the protection itself.
The suffix -ial forms tutorial from tutor.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ial 由 tutor 构成 tutorial。

items.meaning: a teacher who guides a small group
items.example: A tutor meets a few students at a time.
Tutorial first describes what belongs to a tutor.
items.exampleCN: tutorial 最初描述属于导师的事物。

items.example: The noun tutorial names the small class.
items.exampleCN: 名词 tutorial 指那堂小班课。

items.meaning: the work of teaching one student
items.example: Tutoring is often paid by the hour.
items.exampleCN: 个别辅导常按小时收费。

items.meaning: a student taught by a tutor
items.example: The tutee brings questions to each session.
items.exampleCN: 受辅导的学生每次上课都带着问题来。

items.example: Under his tutelage the students learned to argue clearly.
items.exampleCN: 在他的指导下，学生们学会了清晰地论证。

definition_zh: 拧；扭；曲折；曲解
definition_en: to turn something round with force, or to bend and change its shape or meaning
core_image: 双手捏住湿毛巾两端，向相反方向用力拧出水来
scene: 厨房水槽边，洗完的抹布还滴着水，有人双手一拧。He twisted the cloth until the last drops fell into the sink.
sceneCN: 这里 twist 是「拧；扭」（第 1 个义项：用两手向相反方向转动）；句意为他一直拧抹布，直到最后几滴水落进水槽。双手反方向拧毛巾的动作，就是这个词的样子。

derivatives.zh: 由 twist 加 -er 构成，义为「龙卷风；扭曲者」
由 twist 加 -ed 构成，义为「扭曲的」
由 twist 加 -y 构成，义为「弯弯曲曲的」

senses.title: The wringing hands
senses.definition: to turn something firmly in opposite directions
senses.definitionCN: 把某物两端向相反方向用力转动
senses.example: He twisted the cloth until the last drops fell into the sink.
senses.exampleCN: 他一直拧抹布，直到最后几滴水落进水槽。
senses.why: The core is force applied in opposite directions to the two ends of a thing.
senses.whyCN: 核心是对物体的两端反向施力。

senses.title: The wrenched joint
senses.definition: to hurt a joint by turning it too far
senses.definitionCN: 因转动过度而损伤关节
senses.example: She twisted her knee on the uneven path.
senses.exampleCN: 她在凹凸不平的小路上扭伤了膝盖。
senses.why: A joint is hurt when it is turned further than its own hinge allows.
senses.whyCN: 关节之所以受伤，是因为被转过了它自身的铰链所允许的限度。

senses.title: The turn in the story
senses.definition: an unexpected change in events or meaning
senses.definitionCN: 事件或含义中出人意料的变化
senses.example: The story takes a strange twist at the end.
senses.exampleCN: 故事在结尾处出现一个奇怪的转折。
senses.why: A plot that changes direction is doing the same thing a rope does.
senses.whyCN: 情节改变方向，做的正是绳子做的那件事。

senses.title: The bent truth
senses.definition: to give words or facts a meaning they do not have
senses.definitionCN: 把话语或事实解释成原本没有的意思
senses.example: The report twisted what she had said.
senses.exampleCN: 那篇报道歪曲了她说过的话。
senses.why: Once twisting moves from cloth to words, it means bending a meaning out of shape.
senses.whyCN: 当「拧」从布转到话语上，它便意味着把原意拧离本形。

intro.en: Twist is a Germanic word for a divided thing, from the same family as two and twin.
intro.cn: twist 是日耳曼语中表示「分成两股」的词，与 two、twin 同族。

items.en: The root meant a fork or a thing split into two strands.
items.cn: 这个词根意为叉或分成两股之物。

items.en: Twist named a doubled thread, two strands wound together.
items.cn: twist 指双股线，两股缠在一起。

items.en: The noun spread from thread to anything turned with force.
items.cn: 名词从线扩展到一切被用力转动的东西。

items.en: The verb took over the action: to twist a rope, a cap, an ankle.
items.cn: 动词接管了动作：拧绳、拧盖、扭伤脚踝。

items.en: Turning words became turning truth, giving the sense of distortion.
items.cn: 转动话语变成转动事实，生出「歪曲」义。

note.en: The first group shares the tw- stem, the second holds other turning verbs.
note.cn: 第一组共享 tw- 词干，第二组是其他表示转动的动词。

entries.definition: Cord made of twisted strands.
A whirlwind or a distorting person.
The joint between hand and arm.
To squeeze by twisting.
To pull out of true shape.
To force into a curve.

normalIntro.en: Twist begins like two because it is about two strands turning round each other.
normalIntro.cn: twist 开头像 two，因为它讲的是两股互相绕转。

normal.en: Twist, twin, twine and two all open with tw-.
normal.cn: twist、twin、twine、two 都以 tw- 开头。

normal.en: A twist in the plot is the same turning, done to events.
normal.cn: 情节转折是把同一个「转」施加到事件上。

normal.en: The -ed form doubles as an adjective: twisted metal.
normal.cn: 过去分词兼作形容词：扭曲的金属。

normal.en: Twist off, twist open, twist the cap.
normal.cn: 常用搭配：twist off、twist open、twist the cap。

normal.en: A twisty road turns again and again.
normal.cn: twisty 的路一转再转。

abstract.en: Water falling from a wrung cloth.
abstract.cn: 从拧干的布里落下的水。

abstract.en: A rope whose two strands spiral round each other.
abstract.cn: 两股互相盘旋的绳子。

abstract.en: A road doubling back behind a hill.
abstract.cn: 在山后折返的路。

examples.en: Twist the cap until you hear a click.
examples.cn: 拧瓶盖，直到听见一声咔哒。

examples.en: He twisted his back lifting the crate.
examples.cn: 他抬箱子时扭伤了背。

examples.en: The plot has a twist that nobody expected.
examples.cn: 情节有一个谁都没想到的转折。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「特维斯」——特地用力往反方向一拧，布就扭成螺旋。

root: 源自中古英语 twist（双股线）、古英语 twist，与 two、twine、twin 同出日耳曼语表示「分股、成双」的词根，同族词有 twister、twisted、twisty。

sensesIntro.en: First the hands turning a cloth, then a harmed joint, then a turn in events, and finally a turn given to the truth.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是双手拧布，再是受伤的关节，再是事件的转折，最后是给事实拧出来的弯。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands wringing a cloth.
core.cn: 核心意象：两手拧一条布。

branches.en: The material branch: force on both ends.
branches.cn: 材料分支：两端受相反的力。

branches.en: The body branch: a joint turned too far.
branches.cn: 身体分支：关节被转过量。

branches.en: The narrative branch: events take a bend.
branches.cn: 叙事分支：事件拐了个弯。

branches.en: The language branch: words are bent to fit.
branches.cn: 语言分支：话语被拧着凑合。

branches.en: The shape branch: spirals in rope and in story.
branches.cn: 形状分支：绳与故事里的螺旋。

intro.en: Twist is a free root with a tw- beginning that marks doubled things, and the family grows with -er and -ed.
intro.cn: twist 是自由词根，开头的 tw- 标记成双之物，词族靠 -er、-ed 扩展。

definition_zh: 台风；西北太平洋热带气旋；台风信号；避风塘
definition_en: a tropical cyclone of the western North Pacific, with winds rotating around a low-pressure centre
core_image: 暖海面上密云堆成巨大螺旋，中心露出安静的圆孔，边缘雨带像裙摆甩动
scene: 渡轮码头挂起风球，广播反复提醒旅客，值班员说 A typhoon is expected to pass south of the islands tomorrow.
sceneCN: 这里 typhoon 指「西北太平洋的热带气旋」（第 1 个义项：暖海生成、风绕低压中心旋转的强风暴）；句意为预计明天会有一个台风从群岛以南经过。

pos.zh: 台风；西北太平洋热带气旋

forms.label: 复合形容词（风力达台风级）

derivatives.zh: 超强台风（持续风速达到规定上限以上的台风）
避风塘；供船只避风的港湾
防台风的；经得起台风侵袭的
